how: A 30-minute instructor-led session on The Avalanche ski and snowboard simulator, with boot hire and a one-on-one warm-up.
A standing-wave surf simulator (SurfRyder) at an aquatic leisure centre, ridden on pool entry plus a surcharge; listing dates from 2014.
Dawn balloon flights with breakfast over the Hawkesbury Valley or Camden, booked through operators such as Cloud 9 Balloon Flights.
Open-air tandem skydives over the beach at Stuart Park, North Wollongong, with coach transfers from Sydney CBD (about 1 hour); no drop zone within the metro area.
Two full-size cable wakeboard lakes with learn-to-ride sessions and kids' programs inside the Panthers complex.
Cable water-skiing (and wakeboarding, kneeboarding) at Cables Wake Park in Penrith; boat-towed skiing not confirmed.
Introductory clay shooting (trap, DTL, skeet) for unlicensed shooters with coaching, equipment and temporary licensing included.
Polo coaching and clinics with private and group lessons at a Richmond polo club; listing is old.
